entries.title: Job 7:1
segments: ¶[Is there] not an appointed time to man upon earth? [are not] his days also like the days of an hireling? {an appointed...: or, a warfare}

entries.title: Job 7:2
segments: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for [the reward of] his work: {earnestly...: Heb. gapeth after}

entries.title: Job 7:3
segments: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

words.text: So am I made to possess

entries.title: Job 7:4
segments: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day. {the night...: Heb. the evening be measured?}

words.text: unto the dawning of the day
. {the night...: Heb. the evening be measured?}

entries.title: Job 7:5
segments: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

entries.title: Job 7:6
segments: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

entries.title: Job 7:7
segments: ¶O remember that my life [is] wind: mine eye shall no more see good. {shall...: Heb. shall not return} {see: to see, that is, to enjoy}

words.text: . {shall...: Heb. shall not return} {see: to see, that is, to enjoy}

entries.title: Job 7:8
segments: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no [more]: thine eyes [are] upon me, and I [am] not. {I am...: that is, I can live no longer}

words.text: [are] upon me, and I [am] not. {I am...: that is, I can live no longer}

entries.title: Job 7:9
segments: [As] the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no [more].

entries.title: Job 7:10
segments: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

entries.title: Job 7:11
segments: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.title: Job 7:12
segments: [Am] I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

entries.title: Job 7:13
segments: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

entries.title: Job 7:14
segments: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

entries.title: Job 7:15
segments: So that my soul chooseth strangling, [and] death rather than my life. {life: Heb. bones}

entries.title: Job 7:16
segments: I loathe [it]; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days [are] vanity.

entries.title: Job 7:17
segments: ¶What [is] man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

words.text: him? and that thou shouldest set

entries.title: Job 7:18
segments: And [that] thou shouldest visit him every morning, [and] try him every moment?

entries.title: Job 7:19
segments: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

words.text: from me, nor let me alone

entries.title: Job 7:20
segments: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

words.text: against thee, so that I am a burden

entries.title: Job 7:21
segments: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I [shall] not [be].

words.text: And why dost thou not pardon
; and thou shalt seek me in the morning
